title: Edit Inventory Part lists its fields in the set order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active tracked part, part A, at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Scroll the window from top to bottom.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • The fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Part Status (Active / Inactive), Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Average Cost, Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch "Track quantities and cost of goods", then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (the bin rows, then "Add Bin Location").
  • "Add Bin Location" has a plus icon before its label.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R4: “The fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Part Status (editing only), Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Average Cost (editing) or Cost (creating), Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch, then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (bin locations, then "Add Bin Location").”
  • S13-R5: “"Add Bin Location" has a plus icon before its label.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
